title: Stripe webhook → payment_events → ota-stripe-events
caption: The receiver trusts only the signature and the tenant rule of its endpoint; the worker never trusts the event body and re-reads the object from Stripe (src/payments/webhooks/webhook-receiver.service.ts, stripe-events.processor.ts, payment-state.ts).

steps.label: POST /webhooks/stripe/velexis/test (or connect/{env}, c/{connectionId}) + Stripe-Signature, raw body
verify signature with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_* (5 min tolerance) → else 400 INVALID_REQUEST signature_invalid
livemode = environment; tenant from metadata.velexis_tenant_id (velexis) or the connection (connect, c/)
payment by metadata.payment_id / PaymentIntent id; INSERT payment_events (source webhook, provider_event_id unique)
stripe.event {tenantId, paymentEventId} (job id = Stripe event id)
steps.note: Redis down or lookup failure: 503, Stripe sends again. A duplicate event id writes no second row. Unknown tenant/payment or any mismatch: 200 without effect (security event in the log).

steps.label: re-read PaymentIntent / charge / refund (never trust the body)
payment-state rules: authorized → captured | canceled; captured never moves back; refunds pending → processing → succeeded | failed; version check
payment and refund rows updated with their payment_events (status_from/status_to); staff alert on disputes
